title: Kusanagi Nene — Gift From Above〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The first day of our Christmas show went pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, but we can't get complacent.
Especially with the Phoenix Stage troupe's lead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Let's keep this momentum and leave them in the dust!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And let's make sure lots and lots of people smile after seeing our show☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's the plan! And I've got an idea that can help us achieve that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A plan?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, you overcame your fears and learned to unleash your true potential.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, it's time for the rest of us to break out of our shells and spread our wings!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I knew it'd be something dumb...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! If we want to break out of our shells, we can start by becoming eggs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't hijack the conversation just to have it get derailed even more!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. A play where we all act like we've turned into eggs could be very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! Rui, don't side with her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Was my plan hatched too prematurely? What if the things that come out of it are more chaotic versions of them...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You made it sound easy, Tsukasa, but...
How do you suggest we actually do that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's... Uh, something for all of us to think about!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... It would need to have an immediate effect for our Christmas show to benefit from it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means... We should try overcoming something that's been challenging to us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would build our confidence and make us more resilient. It may even enable us to perform at our best under any circumstances.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yikes. That look in Rui's eyes... He's definitely plotting something weird. We might be better off practicing as usual.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But overcoming personal difficulties is no easy matter. I don't think we have the time for this now, so let's just keep doing things the way we have been for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good thinking, Rui! Then improving the quality of our shows will surely allow us to grow as actors!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! I like your idea too! The better we all get, the more smiles we can bring♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Guys, you can't be serious...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Since most of us are for it, I'll go and get what we'll need. Wait here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I tried stopping him... No one can blame me for what happens now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oof! There...
Sorry for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's a fairly hefty box...
What's in it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A surprise.
Why don't you see for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay. Let's get it open... A-Aaargh!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, gross. Centipedes, spiders...
Are these all just toy bugs...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's right.
I wanted to use them for the Halloween show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We went with a zombie theme in the end, so I didn't get any use of them... Hehe. Until now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They didn't need to see daylight, ever! Is this what you meant by overcoming challenges?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. You're scared of bugs, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and he's particularly afraid of ones with many legs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? Where are you going, Tsukasa? Don't you want to break out of your shell and unlock your true potential?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have to become masters of our own fears if we are to stage the most wonderful of shows!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wow, Rui's sadistically enjoying Tsukasa's misery...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's cure your phobia, Tsukasa!
It's time for... A bug shower!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Gyaaah!
Not all at once!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eek! Get away...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to get away from Tsukasa or they'll get on me too! Oh, I know!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Robo-Nene! Protect me!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Nene, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. Shield me from the bugs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! No fair, Nene!
Protect me too...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Get away from me, you idiot!
You're the target here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I only brought something for Tsukasa this time, and I wouldn't want you to get bored, Emu. Would you mind helping me cure his phobia?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sure, I'm on it! Ready... Aim... Fire!
It's raining creepy crawlies, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: Nooooo!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... I can't take it... Anymore...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You guys, we're high schoolers...
Why are we playing dumb kiddie games like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! That was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe for you! It was hellish for me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see an opening. Take that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gyaaah! Not another centipede!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it looks like you weren't able to overcome your fears this time. We'll have to think of another way to help you break out of your shell.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! Let's put wings on these and fly them at Tsukasa like they're really alive!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
NO!
Stop making my trauma worse!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Sigh... These guys are so dumb...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But maybe the crazy stuff they get up to is a little fun sometimes...)
